author: reek
body: Screen-space ambient occlusion over the shared G-buffer. Each pixel reads its own hit distance, then samples a golden-angle spiral of neighbours' distances from the depth buffer (through a storage-pointer helper parameter); a neighbour that is modestly closer counts as an occluder. The occlusion fraction darkens the pixel -- so contact creases between the clustered spheres go dark. A cheap diffuse term (from the normal buffer) keeps the spheres readable. Reference site's "screen space ambient occlusion" technique. Float math from DeviceMath.

author: reek
body: Fold over the spiral taps: sample the depth buffer at each neighbour; a neighbour whose distance is modestly smaller (closer) than ours occludes. buf is a storage pointer.
